utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What do you need from me on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just let me know what parts you can cover, and I’ll fill in the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can cover the plumbing parts and maybe a couple of switches. Tell me what still needs buying.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a wrench if you need it for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I might need that after I figure out where I left mine.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, I’ve got a wrench you can borrow when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard they’re trying to get the repair drive moving again by the weekend. I can ask around and see who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around after lunch and see who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — I noticed the west gate hinge is loose, and the porch light by the repair drive is flickering.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take care of both. I’ll check the hinge and the porch light so we can get the repair drive back in shape.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re meeting at the repair drive this Saturday, right? I can send out a quick invite to everyone on my block.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll spread the word tonight and make sure everyone on my block knows.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’ve got the repair drive on my list. Tell me what’s needed, and I’ll help line it up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring the patch list and a few screws. Just tell me the time and where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll set you down for Saturday morning at my place on the block. Bring the list and screws, and I’ll have the rest ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I agree to anything, can you tell me what the repair drive needs and when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It needs tools, paint, and a few hands for the patching, and it starts Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. I can help with Saturday morning, and I’ll bring my tools and some paint if that works.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I check our schedule, but I need to make sure it doesn’t conflict with pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, that helps. Just let me know the pickup window, and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check our pickup window now and get back to you shortly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon, but I’m a bit out of the loop. Is there anything I should know before it starts?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it’s mostly just a heads-up: bring any small broken thing you want fixed, and the folks running it will sort the rest. I can tell you the time and place once I get the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, that helps. Just let me know the time and place when you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean you can really help with it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I mean it. I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you point me to the nearest pile of parts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, follow me. I think the parts are by the garage, unless I already moved them...

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Lead the way, and I’ll check whether they’re actually there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help with that repair drive. I’ll tell Cleo we’re on it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks. I’ll keep track of the supplies and make sure we’re covered for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, we’re on it, and I’ll pass that along to Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up, and I can swing by after I finish errands if you still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can stay a bit after errands too if that helps. Just tell me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was meaning to ask if you still need a hand with it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I could use a hand. I’m still lining up the repair drive stuff for this week.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, absolutely. Just tell me where you want me to start, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed a message, but I can help catch up now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, just help with the pickup and any parts you can grab.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’ll handle pickup and grab whatever parts I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli. I can bring a few tools by and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Let’s set a time and keep it simple: bring the tools by tomorrow morning, and I’ll have the drive ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli. I’ll bring the tools by tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can help with that repair drive. Let me know what needs fixing and I’ll do my part.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll spread the word and make sure you get the list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, I’ll be ready when you send the list and I’ll take care of my part.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks for organizing it, Opal. I can help spread the word and see who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules. I’ll keep track of who still needs help and pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’ll keep checking in and help connect anyone who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, Cleo. Tell me which homes still need a check, and I’ll line up the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the Elm and Pine houses still needing a check. I’ll mark the rest as covered and keep an eye out for any last-minute gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll focus on Elm and Pine and keep the volunteer list updated if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive coming up, but I’m a little behind on the details. Did Mina say what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard they still need tools, basic supplies, and a few volunteers to sort donations. I can ask Mina if there’s a posted list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo. I need to juggle the school pickup, so can we do the repair drive after 3:30?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: After 3:30 works for me. I can swing by then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take a look at the repair drive list and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you can actually check the list yourself, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can check it myself and help sort it out.
